headline: CLN5 disease and CLN6 disease break the same recycling system in nerve cells

steps.text: In CLN5 disease, nerve cells cannot properly break down waste in their lysosomes, so it builds up (reported in a research paper).
The same lysosomal build-up is reported in CLN6 disease, which is why the atlas links the two communities.

uncertainties: Both links come from a single (mock) paper; they have not been independently confirmed.
The broken protein is different: CLN6 sits in a membrane, CLN5 is soluble — so treatments may not transfer.
what_to_check_next: Ask a CLN5/CLN6 researcher whether the two diseases block the same step of lysosomal breakdown.
